summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, rejecting any proposal to sunset or eliminate it, and emphasizes the importance of reliable broadband for modern education.

claims.argument: E-Rate is essential infrastructure for modern public education and supports myriad operational and instructional functions in schools
claims.evidence_quote: We rely on digital tools and devices on a daily basis, in and out of the classroom. This requires our district to have strong wireless network and technology infrastructure similar to what high tech companies have- on a fraction of the budget.
